settings.cardSearch.intro: Click a binding, then press the key to assign. Esc cancels; Alt can't be bound. Reusing a key moves it here and unbinds its previous owner.
settings.cardSearch.searchButton: In-game search button (by the card list)
settings.cardSearch.searchButtonOn: Magnifying glass next to the game's card-list book toggles the search.
settings.cardSearch.dragFromDetailOn: Drag the detail portrait to pull out a floating card.
settings.cardSearch.dragFromGridOn: Drag a grid card to pull out a floating card.
settings.cardSearch.dragFromGridOff: Grid drag-out off (a grid click just selects).
settings.cardSearch.hideDraggedWithAppOn: Dragged cards hide with the overlay.
settings.cardSearch.hideDraggedWithAppOf: Dragged cards stay on screen when the overlay closes.
settings.trinkets.intro: A box appears for each trinket you are actually holding. That is usually two, but several lesser trinkets end up as a second greater one, and anomalies can hand out more — so up to four boxes are available to position.
settings.trinkets.footer: In match: right-click a trinket card to close it until the match ends, or turn the HUD off.
settings.anomaly.footer: In match: right-click the anomaly card to close it until the match ends, or turn the HUD off.
settings.mmr.intro: Pick where it shows, then what it shows. Any combination works.
settings.mmr.portraitsOn: Rating/name labels on the leaderboard portraits.
settings.mmr.portraitsOff: No labels on the portraits. Tavern tiers and the ⚔ marker are separate settings — they can stay by the portraits on their own.
settings.mmr.panelOn: Standings panel on — drag it anywhere over the game; drag its top-right corner to resize.
settings.mmr.namesHeroesHint: Hero names instead of battletags — nothing identifies the player.
settings.mmr.namesNoneHint: No name column at all; just place, rating and tier.
settings.mmr.ratingOn: Ratings shown (8000↓ below the leaderboard cutoff).
settings.mmr.deltasOn: Daily ▲/▼ deltas shown next to the rating.
settings.mmr.tiersBothHint: Tier icons by the portraits and in the panel.
settings.mmr.tiersPortraitsHint: Tier icons right of each leaderboard portrait only.
settings.mmr.tiersPanelHint: Tier icons inside the side panel only.
settings.mmr.typesBothHint: Each player's most common minion type — under the tier icon by the portrait, and in the panel.
settings.mmr.typesPortraitsHint: Type icon under each leaderboard portrait's tier icon only.
settings.mmr.typesPanelHint: Type icon inside the side panel only.
settings.mmr.lastOpponentOn: The previous combat's opponent gets a ⚔ marker by their portrait.
settings.darkGifts.intro: What the panel shows. Right-clicking the panel in game cycles these too.
settings.darkGifts.modeBothDesc: The full panel — gifts, plus the guaranteed-type minions when they apply.
settings.darkGifts.modeMinionsDesc: Only the guaranteed-type minion arts; the panel stays hidden when no pool applies.
settings.darkGifts.poolCount: Max amount of minions to show
settings.darkGifts.poolZeroHint: The guaranteed tribe is named; none of its minions are drawn.
settings.darkGifts.poolHint: At most {0} of the guaranteed tribe's minions, sole gift-enablers first. Fewer when its pool is smaller.
settings.darkGifts.footer: In match: a “?” sits above the Dark Discovery button — click it and the panel opens in the top-right corner. Close it with the ✕ or a click anywhere else. Scroll it with the wheel; right-click it to cycle these modes.
settings.recap.intro: When a solo Battlegrounds match ends, a small panel in the top-left shows this game's APM and damage dealt next to your averages, once at least {0} matches are recorded. Drag it to move it.
settings.recap.autoDismiss: Hide it 10 s into the next match
settings.recap.autoDismissOn: The recap closes on its own 10 s after the next match starts.
settings.recap.autoDismissOff: The recap stays until you close it.
settings.recap.historyReset: History reset — the averages start over from your next match. The records stay on disk.
settings.updates.availableText: Update v{0} is available. The download and the release notes are on the release page; run install.bat from the zip to update.
settings.common.arrangeHint: Brings Hearthstone to the front and shows just this, on its own. Drag it to move; drag its top-right corner to resize. Click Done here when it's where you want it.
settings.common.hsNotRunningDetail:
Hearthstone isn't running.

This draws on top of the game, so there is nothing to position yet. Start Hearthstone, then click Arrange again.
settings.common.arranging: Arranging — drag it to move, drag its top-right corner to resize. Click Done when finished.

settings.cardSearch.listening: Listening for a key... (Esc to cancel)
settings.cardSearch.altNotBindable: Alt can't be bound - press another key.
settings.language.cardAutoHint: Card names, text and art follow the Hearthstone client's language ({0}). A Russian client gets English.
settings.language.cardEnglishHint: English card names, text and art, whatever language the client runs in.
settings.language.cardHint: Card names, text and art in {0}; the search understands {0} and English words.

settings.language.pluginEnglishHint: The plugin's own menus and messages in English.
